findings.description: When ANSI stripping applies, the prompt text is also stripped of leading and trailing whitespace, so a prompt such as "Name: " is passed to input() as "Name:" and loses its separating space.
findings.rationale: Trigger: prompt("Name: ") or confirm(...) runs with a stream that does not support color, for example when stdout is piped, so should_strip_ansi returns true. Mechanism: strip_ansi(text).strip() removes the trailing space from the prompt before func(text) writes it. Impact: the user sees "Name:" with the typed input running directly against the colon, a visible formatting regression on a common non-TTY path. The intended change only needed ANSI removal, not whitespace trimming.
